units.source_text: 我的想法也许是很难理解。

en.t: My way of thinking may be very hard to understand.

units.source_text: 币过，从那以后，我安下心来，相信"爱是不可能的"。

en.t: However, from that time on, I became at ease, believing that "love is impossible."

units.source_text: 这一点，你也许会理解的吧。

en.t: This point, perhaps, you may understand.

units.source_text: 就是说，没有不安，也没有爱。

en.t: That is to say, without unease, there is no love either.

units.source_text: 世界永久地处在停止状态，同时也达到目标。

en.t: The world remains forever in a state of stillness, and at the same time it has reached its goal.

units.source_text: 有没有必要给这个世界注为"我们的世界"呢？

en.t: Is there any need to annotate this world as "our world"?

units.source_text: 我过去可以用一句话来给人世间的"爱"的迷惘下一个定义。

en.t: In the past, I could define in a single sentence the delusion of "love" in the human world.

units.source_text: 这就是虚像与实像企囹相结合的迷惘……

en.t: It is the delusion in which the false image and the real image try to join together...

units.source_text: 不久，我知道我绝不会被人爱，我的这种境信就是人类存在内根本状态。

en.t: Before long, I knew that I would never be loved by anyone, and this conviction of mine was the fundamental state within human existence.

units.source_text: 这就是我失去重贞的来龙去脉。

en.t: This is the whole course of how I lost my chastity.
